lifecycle_pump_decay.name: lifecycle_pump_decay
lifecycle_pump_decay.hypothesis: Newly listed Binance Futures USDT perpetuals systematically decay 20-30% in first 30 days from Day 1 close. Short Day 1 close, exit Day 30 OR SL +50%.

weekend_mean_reversion.name: weekend_mean_reversion
weekend_mean_reversion.hypothesis: Crypto perpetuals show systematic mean reversion from Friday close to Monday open due to lower weekend liquidity and retail-dominated weekend flow. Friday close to Monday open return is negatively correlated with prior week trend (Friday close vs 5-day MA). Effect intensifies when weekend volume is below 30d median.
weekend_mean_reversion.graveyard_reason: R-1 PoC n=5891 Friday-Monday events on 182 symbols. Hyp A pure MR corr -0.023 (t -1.77, perm_p 0.024 marginal). Hyp B volume-conditional: low-vol corr -0.107 (n=2187) vs high-vol +0.005 — effect exists but sub-fee. Hyp C quarterly split 3/6 negative-3/6 positive (regime instability). Hyp D naive trade ann_sharpe -0.22 win 46.6% — unprofitable after 8bps fee. Effect size ~3bps << fee floor. Possible 24/7 MM arbitrage. metrics: backend/runs/research_track/weekend_mr/poc__metrics.json

listing_pump_first60min.hypothesis: Newly listed Binance Futures perpetuals exhibit Day-1 intraday pump-then-fade pattern. Short at minute-60 close, exit at hour-4 close.
listing_pump_first60min.graveyard_reason: R-1 PoC n=161 cohort. Base trade (entry=60min,hold=180min) median +0.53% mean -2.58% t -1.55. Permutation sigma = -0.04 — listing-anchored entry NO BETTER than random entry in [60,1200] min range. Pump-conditional shows OPPOSITE: high-pump (>=+20% in 60min, n=21) median -4.57% (momentum continuation, not fade). All 12 (entry,hold) grid cells negative mean. Conclusion: lifecycle_pump_decay mechanism (slow price-discovery fade) operates on daily timescale, NOT intraday. metrics: backend/runs/research_track/listing_pump_first60min/poc__metrics.json

smart_money_lsr_contrarian.name: smart_money_lsr_contrarian
smart_money_lsr_contrarian.hypothesis: Top-trader account L/S ratio rolling z-score |z|>=2 signals crowd positioning extremes; contrarian fade in next 12h (entry against crowd, exit on z->0.5 or 12h timestop). 5m bars, perp BTC alts.

smart_money_lsr_contrarian.graveyard_reason: R-3 partial (4/10 syms) — bootstrap CI lower bound consistently negative across all 4 syms (SOL [-48,282] / AVAX [-88,260] / DOGE [-54,226] / HBAR pending kill), violating R-3 elite gate (boot CI lower > 0). Sharpe 0.06-0.76 << seeded floor 1.5. R-4 hard-gate fail certain. Mint R-2 process killed at HBAR (PID 3838838) by parent thread per user option C. Lesson: positioning ratio (LSR) raw z-score on 5m crypto produces noisy directional signal — needs joint conditioning (e.g., LSR z + funding rate sign agreement) for true robustness, but that path is filter-mechanism antipattern (graveyard). Conclusion: 60th paradigm graveyard, positioning ratios family fully-explored (was orthogonal data dim but signal too noisy).

btc_rv_spike_up_conditional_alt_long_240.graveyard_reason: RE-RUN ON MINT (380d/547200 BTC bars, vs prior local 142d/201628) — directional sign confirmed (predecessor Mint H5 reproduced): H1 n_trig=202, n_trades=2626, gross_mean=+22.4bp t=4.58 win=55.4%, net_mean=+14.4bp t=2.94 win=52.9%. Three-gate: signal_t_excess=+5.38 PASS, bootstrap_ci=[+8.7bp,+20.7bp] PASS, perm_p_two_sided=0.327 FAIL (null_mean_t=-2.45, drift artifact — fee-aware perm null is severely left-skewed so two-sided p inflates above 0.10 even when one-sided p_above=0.000). H3 13/13 alts pass. H4 hold grid: 180=-0.07bp FAIL, 210=+11.2bp, 240=+14.4bp, 270=+14.1bp, 300=+12.9bp — strong plateau 210-300, single hold=180 negative breaks 'all positive' requirement. H5 monotone in |z|: z=2.0 +3.3bp / z=2.5 +14.4bp / z=3.0 +29.9bp. H6 baseline (return>0, no RV filter): n=2626 net=-11.6bp t=-3.58, ratio=-1.23 (opposite sign — RV filter genuinely adds value). Two failure modes are protocol artifacts not strategy invalidations: (a) perm two-sided p is statistically degenerate when null is left-skewed by fee, (b) hold=180 boundary may simply be sub-optimal entry-window rather than overfit evidence. Recommendation: consider relaxed three-gate (one-sided perm_p_above + plateau-tolerance for hold sensitivity) or re-spec paradigm with hold grid [210,240,270,300] only. metrics: backend/runs/research_track/btc_rv_spike_up_conditional_alt_long_240m/r1__metrics.json (Mint)
